title: Fracture Hub
features:
Autoplay

One-toggle master autoplay
Auto Upgrade — spends cash as it comes in
Auto Target and Auto Ability (by name)
Cycle Game Speed and Skip Modifier Vote
Auto Vote Start (ready up in intermission)
Auto Vote Restart or Auto Leave on game over
Macro

Record and play back full placement runs
Auto Replay Each Match
Farm mode — rejoin until a paired map, per-map/difficulty pairings
Auto-detect maps, wait-for-money retries
Export/Import macros as JSON
Smart Auto Ability

Rule-based ability casting per tower
DJ and Commander presets with confirmed casts
Server-clock timing so abilities fire the moment they're ready
Rewards

Claim all gifts, playtime rewards, daily spin and quests
Redeem all codes + auto-redeem new codes (scraped live)
One-toggle Auto Claim for everything
Client & Performance

Low Performance Mode (kills VFX), Limit FPS, flat Performance UI
Delete Map / Delete Enemies / Black Screen (client-side)
Anti-AFK (no kick), Max Camera Zoom, Streamer Mode
Auto Sell all towers (now or at a set wave)
Return to Match at game over — rejoins win or lose
Placement

Start Match, Ready Up, and Auto Queue matchmaking
Discord Webhook

Embeds on match complete, match start and wave milestones
Optional ping and username censor
General

Key system, mobile support, saved profiles per account, auto-updates, theme and accent customization
